globalStandards.palette: Warm ivory, mushroom/mineral, quiet natural matte oak and warm walnut are the fixed architectural base. Dark frames and restrained hardware remain. Owned polished nickel/stainless and neutral new furniture are localized furnishing finishes, not a Cocoa & Chrome blue/yellow palette.
globalStandards.acceptedStoneChoices: Study A pearl onyx-look porcelain at owners bathing walls; C1 quiet cream quartzite-look porcelain kitchen counters/backsplash/waterfall; Study E pale limestone-look porcelain shared-bath vanity wall/short return. Keep the current fireplace finish because D1/D3 alternatives were not finally chosen.
globalStandards.dryAndWetSeparation: Premium washable matte acrylic for general dry walls and appropriate bathroom paint outside wet surfaces. Decorative mineral finishes are restricted to approved dry fields. Wet areas require a complete trade-designed waterproofing assembly; tile, grout and Roman Clay topcoat are not substitutes.
globalStandards.woodAndStairs: Approve one physical neutral oak sample against the second-floor reference. All four bedrooms use wood floors with loose rugs. All stair treads/landings remain exposed oak without runners, mats or rods. Inspect stair/guard condition and maintain safe finished transitions.
globalStandards.joinery: Approve measured elevations, representative veneer/edge samples, appliance and AV cutouts, mounting support, service access, ventilation and accessible LED drivers before fabrication. Use retained serviceable boxes or well-detailed modular carcasses where they achieve the same accepted design.
globalStandards.sampleGate: Review paint, mineral texture, porcelain/grout, oak, walnut and textiles together under actual daylight and the proposed lamps. Photoreal renders cannot approve color, sheen, waterproofing or physical tolerances.
globalStandards.electricalControlNote: The control groups below describe independent switching/dimming intent. They are not branch-circuit schedules, permit documents or assumed electrical capacities. The electrician designs actual loads, wiring, protection, mounting and inspections after equipment is chosen.
globalStandards.sequence: Work across the vacant house by trade for survey, rough electrical/plumbing/HVAC and blocking before closing walls. Finish substrates and waterproofing before final wall finishes, flooring and coordinated joinery. Install tracks/privacy layers after mounting support is prepared; deliver furniture last and commission each room after dark. The move-in roadmap remains the separate timing authority.
globalStandards.procurement: No piece is represented as purchase-ready solely because it appears in a render. Fresh selected finish/fabric, quantity, actual fit, delivery route and ZIP 20878 availability checks are required. Keep rejected alternatives separate; do not double-order or duplicate owned pieces.
globalStandards.romanClayManufacturerReference: For the Portola Roman Clay option, use properly prepared smooth interior drywall, preferably Level 5, and its specified primer/application system. It is not for wet areas, exterior walls, trim, doors or cabinets. The optional protective topcoat adds protection and some sheen; it does not make the finish waterproof. Final brand and physical color remain unselected.
